title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
The Spanish Data Protection Agency has received what it describes as the first reported personal data breach carried out by an artificial intelligence agent. An unnamed organization said an attacker used an AI agent with a well known language model to log in successfully, then autonomously search for weaknesses in an application. Once inside, the agent altered personal data and accessed invoices. The agency noted that this does not mean the AI model or its provider was compromised, and the details still need formal analysis.

The agency said this single case is not a statistical trend but a clear sign that AI driven attacks are becoming real. It urged companies to include AI assisted attacks in risk assessments, speed up detection and response, and tighten control of credentials and access. The notification will now be examined by the regulator, while organizations are advised to review their security and data protection measures.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
